title: Their magnetic fields are trillions of times stronger than Earth's.
narration: These are the universe's ultimate magnets. Their magnetic fields are trillions of times stronger than Earth's, so powerful they can rip atoms to shreds. They warp spacetime and trap particles in beams of pure energy. It's a force beyond comprehension.
